candidates.name: B1-compression
candidates.role: stack compression only: porosity down, separator 12->8um, collectors 16/12->12/8um - probe W3 ceiling without thickness change

candidates.name: B2-thicken-balanced
candidates.role: thicker electrodes amortize overhead; balanced N/P; higher capacity per area

candidates.name: B3-NP-up
candidates.role: aggressive anode margin (N/P ~1.49) to kill 4C plating, moderate cathode thickening for W3

candidates.name: B4-electrolyte
candidates.role: high-transport electrolyte formulation proxy: sigma 0.95->1.2 S/m (+26% estimate), D +24% (estimate), transference 0.2594->0.45 (single-ion-conductor blend, estimate); scalar overrides are T-independent, matching this set's already T-independent sigma/D functions - no Arrhenius bypass

llm_reason: baseline gap analysis: W3 843.49 vs 880 (-36.5) and 4C plating failure (anode saturates at end of charge). Compression amortizes overhead fraction; thickening raises capacity per stack volume AND (at fixed nominal current) lowers areal current - but C-rate honesty requires re-nominalizing: candidates whose measured 1C capacity differs materially from nominal 5.0 Ah get 'Nominal cell capacity [A.h]' overridden to their measured capacity so the 1C/4C tests reflect the designed cell's own rates (recorded procedure; avoids shortcut-dependence). B2/B3/B4 first probed at nominal 5A to measure capacity, then re-run at re-nominalized current. B1 expected within 3% of 5.0 so nominal kept.
